status: VNDRLY-authored training and internal exam; external validation and acceptance pending

items.required: Check all 42 benchmark mappings against actual lesson paragraphs, scenarios and assessment coverage, document omissions and resolve them before any external equivalence claim.

items.owner: Qualified regulatory reviewers for actual industry/jurisdiction
items.required: Validate applicability, current federal/state requirements and task exclusions in every OSHA row; review actual employer/site evidence. This is an author-prepared coverage register, not a compliance determination.

items.owner: Assessment specialist independent of course sales
items.required: Job/knowledge analysis, examination blueprint and item review, defensible passing standard, accessibility/fairness, item statistics, retest exposure and retention study. Current 80% threshold is provisional VNDRLY policy.

items.owner: Qualified instructors and learner pilot reviewers
items.required: Evaluate teaching accuracy, comprehension, learner duration, accessibility and delivery. Self-paced publication is not evidence of eight instructional hours or equivalence to instructor-led delivery.

items.owner: VNDRLY credential governance and independent auditor
items.required: Validate identity assurance/proctoring, security, privacy, records, complaints/appeals, conflicts of interest, version changes, suspension/revocation and any chosen accreditation route. Current exam is account-authenticated, not independently proctored.

Written acceptance naming the VNDRLY course/version, delivery method, assessment, location/service/role, required additions and validity. No PEC/SafeLand/SafeGulf/IADC approval or universal partner acceptance is claimed.

items.owner: Accrediting body if accreditation is pursued
items.required: External application, curriculum/delivery/instructor audits and formal approval. Published objective coverage does not grant accreditation or permission to issue another organization’s credential.

items.owner: Qualified practical assessors and responsible employer
items.required: Observe actual applicable PPE, vehicle/equipment, isolation, gas testing, rescue and other task skills; identify worker/assessor/competence basis/equipment/method/criteria/result/date/limitations/reassessment, then employer authorization.

This release is English. Validate translations and alternative accessible instruction/assessment for learners needing them; do not treat English completion as proof of understanding in another language.
